title: DPS K-9 Malina Tracks Fugitive 1.7 Miles Along U.S. 83 South
excerpt: A Texas DPS K-9 named Malina tracked a fugitive 1.7 miles in 37 minutes along U.S. 83 South near Laredo on Oct. 29, finding the person on a private ranch near the highway, according to KGNS.
content:
A Texas Department of Public Safety K-9 named Malina tracked a fugitive 1.7 miles along U.S. 83 South near Laredo, finding the person on a private ranch near the highway, according to KGNS.

Around 1 p.m. on Oct. 29, 2026, U.S. Border Patrol asked DPS for help tracking the person, KGNS reported. Malina followed the trail for 1.7 miles, a track that took 37 minutes.

Border Patrol later confirmed the person was in the country illegally, according to KGNS.

DPS said its K-9 tracking program has become a crucial tool, helping other agencies find fugitives and assisting with rescue operations, KGNS reported.

Source: KGNS, Nov. 14, 2026.
